section1.title: 1. Physical Locker Usage Regulations
section1.foodPolicy: ZIPBOX allows users to send food items and senders must select "item is food" when operating on the PWA.
section1.foodTimeLimit: For food items, ZIPBOX only holds for a maximum of 24 hours. ZIPBOX will notify via app or call directly to remind customers to pick up continuously after every 3/6/12/24 hours. After 24 hours, if unable to contact the recipient or food order is still not collected, ZIPBOX will remove the order from the locker to ensure hygiene for subsequent users.
section1.prohibitedContent: Users are strictly prohibited from using ZIPBOX lockers to store or send items in the following categories: hazardous, flammable, explosive substances; drugs and banned substances; weapons, ammunition; illegal goods; live animals; and other items prohibited from circulation under Vietnamese law. ZIPBOX reserves the right to cooperate with authorities to handle violations.
